text: State Comp. Ins. Fund (1992) 8 CA4th 78, 89, 9 CR2d 894, 901] a. [3:536] Includes emotional distress claims: No civil action lies for claims for emotional distress and mental anguish “arising out of and in the course of employment.” Such claims are preempted by the exclusivity provisions of the workers' compensation law, notwithstanding the absence of any compensable physical disability.
